item.title: Zugerujk.net v1.3.7
item.description: Sorry for not updating for, like, over two months? I had to work a lot on IOODancing, which led to a wrist injury, and also I just didn't have a very great summer emotionally, and also I moved two weeks ago, to a new apartment across town. But today I had the energy. Island Off Outer Dancing is now out — go play it! All I did here was add my SGDQ2026 recap and Gigantic Ultra Consumables Review to the blog feed, which both took forever to write. And I tried fixing the RSS feed, so, hopefully it's fixed!

item.title: Zugerujk.net v1.3.5
item.description: Big news! There's now a page for Island Off Outer Dancing as well as an IOOD Press Kit. To accommodate this, the Outer Darkness tab on the navbar now links to an Island Off Outer Duology landing page, where you can get to sub-pages (and to be clear, I felt very clever when I realized I could call the two games that). No blog posts in this one, as I've been extremely busy working on IOODancing. Go wishlist Island Off Outer Dancing! It'll be free but the engagement still helps.
